s.d: a sheet of specially prepared animal skin on which one could write with pen and ink; books or scrolls made of such skin
s.c: In ⟦2 Timothy 4:13|2 Timothy 4:13⟧ the reference may be to documents written on parchment or to blank sheets of parchment. Sheets of parchment were either sewn together in long scrolls or, in later developments, bound together into book form (see LN 6.66).
